item.title: Voice to AI
item.description: I haven’t started using dots yet. Apparently you can use your voice to design a rocketship and build it in Blender. OK, so what is. It’s the voices API plus an integration, perhaps an MCP server. I’m not there yet. I’ve tried voice before with mixed results. I think there’s a lot of potential, but we’re going to see a lot of weirdness as we learn how to build. I’m seeing this on Reddit with AI job interviewers.
